items.q: And then in later years Lena Horne moved out here and Jackie Robinson and Campanella and Ella Fitzgerald and Earl Bostick.

ctx.x: And then in later years Lena Horne moved out here and Jackie Robinson and Campanella and Ella Fitzgerald and Earl Bostick. So this community moved -- Babe Ruth was in this neighborhood in the early days when it was a white community. Babe -- It was a sportsmen's community where Babe Ruth lived, the great baseball player, Earl Sande, the great jockey.
